page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin, each beside its line. Running head at top; page number at top right. Catchword-like word "bilitri" at foot is a line-end fragment, and "P 2" is a signature at the foot.

main_text.p: cum Scoto & Durando, Transsubstantiationem cum Bibliis & ratione pugnare, ut species & substantia panis remaneant integræ, in Eucharistia, & soli standum Ecclesiæ authoritati.In 4. sent. qu. 6. 2 S
Biel dicit, non inveniri in Canone Bibliæ quomodo sit corpus Christi in Eucharistiæ Sacramento: adeoque illi fidem astruit ab Ecclesiæ authoritate.Lect. 49. can. missæ.

Idem facit Roffensis. Hactenus Matthæus qui & solus novi Testamenti meminit, neque ullum verbum hic positum est, quo probatur in nostra missa fieri carnis & sanguinis Christi veram præsentiam. Igitur per ullam Scripturam probari nequit.

Cajetani sententiam discamus ex Suaresio Jesuita. Ex Catholicis solus Cajetanus in commentario hujus articuli, qui jussu Pii quinti in Romana editione expunctus est, docuit seclusa authoritate Ecclesiæ verba illa hoc est corpus meum ad confirmandam hanc veritatem non sufficere. Porro clausula expuncta hæc est: quod Evangelium non explicavit expressè ab Ecclesia accepimus, videlicet conversionem panis in corpus Christi.Tom. 3. disp. 46.Tom. 3. qu. 75.

Alphonsus de Castro pariter vult stari potius authoritati Ecclesiæ quam verbis Scripturæ aut testimonio Patrum: nam de Transsubstantiatione (inquit) panis in corpus Christi rara est in antiquis scriptoribus mentio.Lib. 6. contra hæreses.
Nec desunt Romanenses qui negent Transsubstantiationem esse Ecclesiæ sententiam. Certè Cardinalis de Alliaco qui interfuit Concilio Constantiensi affirmabat, non posse stabiliri

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are abbreviated references (In 4. sent. qu. 6; Lect. 49. can. missæ; Tom. 3. disp. 46; Tom. 3. qu. 75; Lib. 6. contra hæreses; 14. sent. qu. 6.). The note "14. sent." and "qu. 6." beside the last paragraph are as printed. The final word "stabiliri" is split across the foot line and is printed as "bilitri" in the signature area; the line is partly damaged. Some pencil marks ("2 S") in the margin are not printed text and are omitted.
